name: Drugs Made In America Acquisition II Corp. Unit
summary: DMIIU is a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), operating as a blank check firm established in the Cayman Islands. Its core objective is to identify and complete a merger or acquisition with an existing business. The company specifically aims to acquire targets within the pharmaceutical and drug industries, driven by the goal of reducing the United States' reliance on international drug manufacturing. Each investment unit comprises one common stock share and an associated right, which entitles the holder to an additional one-tenth of a share once a suitable business combination is successfully finalized.
